name: Elyon
source:
Elyon is a high-ranking angel sent from the Heavens to observe the Underworld's restructuring and judge whether the reapers are fit to govern themselves post-revolution. Unfortunately, he finds its inhabitants and their methods largely distasteful, and has attracted the attention of one particularly devious Grim Reaper...
